reviewScope.summary: PR96 successor: exact five-selector Playwright correction across achievements, programme switching and XP tests. Previous implementation and test corrections preserved. Hosted Final candidate and production activation remain separate gates.
evidence: Owner-provided local candidate identity: d6d06868ff2eb766c1a2da6a965c01cd820634d0, payload tree 6421b9e72999e687afe79bae66597dab807b5043; five changed files, 30 insertions and 14 deletions. The commit was not yet pushed when reviewed.

GPT-6 reviewed the uploaded git show patch covering RpgRouteShell.tsx, MicroShell.tsx, microFeedbackSlot.ts, the microlearning public entrypoint and microSession.test.tsx. The new context is React-only and feature-local; the app consumes it through @/features/microlearning, preserving the app import boundary.

The existing router.tsx, inspected from the public PR branch, places both MicrolearningRoute and MicroTrackRoute under RpgRouteShell. Its ready-state provider surrounds DataEpochOutlet, and loading/error states continue to render FeedbackWidget directly. The existing immersive header injects the action where the old direct FeedbackWidget was rendered.

The revised microSession test setup explicitly supplies the same feedback action through MicroFeedbackSlot.Provider. This preserves interactive feedback-button and focus-related test coverage within the focused suite; it does not replace independent end-to-end browser evidence.

Owner-reported preflight on this local candidate: git diff --check, changed-file Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript typecheck, circular dependency check (562/562 analyzed, no cycles), Vite production build and bundle-budget check all passed. The bundle report recorded zero violations and warnings; JavaScript gzip total 461632 bytes against 470000-byte maximum.

adversarialFindings.description: The feedback interface is present while the server-side inbox can still be disabled.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The API fails closed unless FEEDBACK_INTAKE_ENABLED=true and a server-side administrator secret exist. An owner-provided Preview screen confirmed a valid receipt after repairing the Nhost credential; production enablement still requires the remaining operational gates.

adversarialFindings.description: Provider firewall coverage, scheduled purge execution and actual learner-role access are not certified by source-only tests.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Synthetic SQL purge and scheduled execution were owner-verified (37 successful runs). A Vercel rate-limit rule was configured, but enforcement and all-hostname coverage have not been independently confirmed, and ordinary-user GraphQL denial still requires a live test. These are operational activation gates, not claims of source-only certification.

adversarialFindings.description: The public feedback form is not an appropriate destination for reporting security vulnerabilities.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The app and both documentation languages direct disclosures to the separate GitHub private vulnerability intake, rather than the feedback service.

adversarialFindings.description: Protected Vercel Preview rejected feedback requests without same-origin credentials.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Client now uses same-origin credentials. Server does not forward browser cookies to Nhost. Focused tests passed.

adversarialFindings.description: The new feedback button changed microlearning keyboard focus order.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Updated the accessibility test to verify both header controls and entry to the first session. Focused test passed.

adversarialFindings.description: The first microlearning feedback integration imported the feedback feature directly inside the isolated microlearning feature, violating its established architecture boundary. The initial repair also introduced an app-layer import of a feature-internal context module, rejected by ESLint.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final five-file successor defines a React-only optional context inside microlearning, exports it from the feature public entrypoint, provides the existing FeedbackWidget action from RpgRouteShell and consumes it in MicroShell without importing feedback. The microSession fixture mirrors this provider. The owner reported 70/70 focused tests, lint, typecheck, circular dependency, build and budget PASS for the local candidate; direct diff review found no remaining restricted import.

adversarialFindings.description: Feedback integration caused inconsistent RPG utility placement and browser-test regressions.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Integrated report and settings controls into the relevant RPG surfaces, fixed test selectors and profile readiness synchronization. Owner-reported geometry and eight focused Chromium tests passed.

retrospective.summary: Proceed with the exact one-line Git E2E timeout correction. The owner explicitly authorized resuming after focused Chromium 1/1 PASS. Implementer self-review; hosted release certification remains pending. Production feedback activation is separately gated.
